findings.issue: The Sage takes the Artisan's own comparison ("Drifting is easier than steering", 水_食神 fr[0]), and "call" appears twice in two sentences. The chips "Lets it drift" (Sage) and "Drifts along" (Artisan) also share their key word. The owner ruled that no Sage keyword is rebuilt, so only the passage changes.
findings.fix: "Whatever you let drift, you leave to someone else. Being carried feels safer than choosing, and the people close to you end up deciding for you. You put on them the weight of every call you dodge." (38)

findings.quote: "Trusting the forced version more than the easy one, you add effort to finished work. Your evenings disappear into polishing what was right the first time."
findings.issue: This is the Virtuoso's cost ("you redo finished work. You spend whole weekends changing things that were already good enough", 水_伤官 cat[1]). It is also out of character for the Artisan, who on the friction pole of the same cell puts "comfort first" and drifts. The Artisan's own price is undervaluing what comes easily.
findings.fix: "Whenever something comes to you without effort, you count it as worth less. You trust the forced version more than the easy one, and the easy one stays in the drawer. You price lowest the things you do best." (40)

findings.quote: "You follow the agreed course through rather than reopen it, and you hold them to a course never rechecked. Those working with you keep to a road that may no longer suit them."
findings.issue: "follow … through" is split awkwardly and "course" appears twice. The close is hedged with "may", and it claims something the reading cannot know.
findings.fix: "Your follow-through covers everyone attached to the plan. You keep to the agreed course rather than reopen it, and you hold them to it without a second look. You lead those working with you down a road nobody has checked since the start." (44)

findings.quote: "you give home a feast with no steady part. Home with you swings between plenty and making do."
findings.issue: "a feast with no steady part" does not parse on first read. "Home with you" assumes a household. On P173 "home" appears 4 times.
findings.fix: "Whenever luck lands, you share it outward first. You share it all at once rather than spread it out, and every feast you throw comes before a long gap. Those who count on you swing between plenty and making do." (41)

findings.quote: "Leading without shouting feels cleaner than a request someone can refuse, and you give the people you steer no yes or no."
findings.issue: It compares an act (leading) with a thing (a request). "give … no yes or no" has to be read twice.
findings.fix: "Arranging beats asking whenever you lead. Setting things up quietly feels cleaner to you than a request someone could turn down, and the people you steer never get a say. Your people travel a calm road and never feel pushed along it." (41)

findings.quote: "you use up the time they needed."
findings.issue: It is unclear what the time was needed for. The real cost is that they lose the chance to reach the thing themselves.
findings.fix: "When someone leaves a thing unsaid, you speak up about it as a kindness. Speaking up rather than waiting for them to work it out, you reach the answer before they can. With you near, nobody has to wonder where they stand." (43)

findings.criterion: house rule (do not assume dependants), D11
findings.quote: "The people who depend on you never have to worry about a sudden bill."
findings.issue: It assumes the reader has dependants, and the drive angle ends on someone else. The original's "so you" joint is replaced.
findings.fix: "You save before you spend, every time. Something put away lets you relax, and you save a little from every month rather than enjoy all of one. You meet a sudden bill with money already set aside." (37)

findings.quote: "hold yours back until perfect"
findings.issue: A word is missing ("until it is perfect"). The "so" joint becomes "and", to keep the fix free of "X, so Y".
findings.fix: "Keeping it in keeps it from being judged. Inside is where an idea stays safe, and you hold yours back until it is perfect rather than let it out rough. You go unheard on the very things you understand best."

findings.quote: "Your mind takes in less"
findings.issue: The function name is capitalised everywhere else ("Your Mind is where…", "Your Action grows…"). (On P171 this field is replaced by W-001.)
findings.fix: "Your Mind takes in less than it could use. Ask one person who knows more than you and wait for the whole reply. Take one free course on a subject that is new to you. Leave one hard question open for a week before you answer it."

findings.quote: "after the easy answer came"
findings.issue: The tense does not match "keep asking".
findings.fix: "Water runs through your mind, your growth and your career. It is the question you keep asking after the easy answer has come, the skill you learned your own way and own for good, and the read you have on someone before the handshake ends."

findings.quote: "something a fire can use. Let it use what Water pours"
findings.issue: "use" appears in two sentences in a row. The fix keeps this core's "Let it" verb.
findings.fix: "Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is fuel that grows: it drinks the rain and turns it into something a fire can burn. Let it use what Water pours on you. You take every rule to heart faster than you take anything in. Start one project of your own this month. Learn one skill no rule asks for."

findings.quote: "You pay for it in ease."
findings.issue: It repeats the close "You pay for being this hard in rest you skip" on the same page.
findings.fix: "Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water keeps it deep, and rules sink in to stay. As a friction, the rules outweigh what you want. You give up ease to keep them."

findings.quote: "best work … one piece of work … how one new task works"
findings.issue: "work" appears 3 times in one field (4 times on P131, P132, P172).
findings.fix: "You do your best work with a date on it and someone waiting at the other end. Ask for honest feedback on one thing you made and just listen. Learn how one new task is done before you start on it. Leave an hour empty between two big jobs."

findings.quote: "than be oversold in a day"
findings.issue: It is unclear who is oversold. The sense is "win trust fast".
findings.fix: "Slowly earned trust is the only trust you believe. You would rather earn trust over a year than win it in a day, since quick trust feels false. Work that needed you this month goes to someone with an easier smile."

findings.quote: "pour and spread as it goes. As a friction, your Action spreads"
findings.issue: The head and the tail meet on "spread / spreads".
findings.fix: "Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Water makes it pour and spread as it goes. As a friction, your Action moves on quicker than it settles. Each opening pulls you on before the last one pays."

findings.quote: "since being wrong costs more"
findings.issue: The comparison is left hanging (more than what?).
findings.fix: "Sleeping on a choice keeps your money safe, and it makes you late. You wait a night before saying yes, since a wrong yes costs more than a slow one. Bargains and good seats often go to whoever answered while you were still weighing it up." (45)

findings.quote: "You put the savings ahead of the trip together"
findings.issue: This is the second of three "put … ahead of" on P138.
findings.fix: "Saving first hands your people the careful version of you. You put the savings before the trip together, and give them caution instead of company. The holidays they hoped to take with you stay in the planning."

findings.quote: "You put being counted on ahead of being exciting"
findings.issue: This is the third "put … ahead of" on P138.
findings.fix: "You show up every day the same way, noticed or not. You value being counted on over being exciting, and you show up on dull days too. Whole teams quietly lean on you without saying so."

findings.quote: "somewhere to go … to see where it goes"
findings.issue: "go / goes" appears in the first and last sentence.
findings.fix: "Your Action grows when it has somewhere to go and something to bring back. Put one plan into motion this season, a trip booked or a small venture opened with money you can spare. Follow one lead you heard about and see what it turns up."

findings.quote: "Water pours it out … you pour out care"
findings.issue: "pour" appears 3 times on the page, counting the remedy.
findings.fix: "Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water pours it out until nothing stays in. As a friction, you spend care faster than it refills, because being needed feels like safety. By evening little is left for your own plans."

findings.quote: "Let it hold what Water pours … Hold to one plan"
findings.issue: "hold" appears twice in one field.
findings.fix: "Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth is the ground under the water, the bank that stills it until it clears. Let it hold what Water pours. You let it all out as it comes, and nothing stays in long enough to settle. Keep one piece of news to yourself for a week. Stick with one plan for a whole month."

findings.quote: "in public rather than private"
findings.issue: The second "in" is missing.
findings.fix: "With whoever is in charge, you pick fights as your own kind of honesty. Because you fight in public rather than in private, you cost the one above you their footing in front of others. You leave them no quiet way to answer you."

findings.quote: "Tell someone one story … Ask one person what they took from it"
findings.issue: "someone" and "one person" read as two different people, so "it" has no clear listener. (On P174 this field is replaced by W-001.)
findings.fix: "What you have to give runs short, and it counts for nothing until someone hears it. Tell one person a story with no lesson in it. Ask them what they took from it, and listen to the end."

findings.quote: "Needing it in pieces first"
findings.issue: It does not parse. The sense is taking it apart first.
findings.fix: "Doing a thing the usual way is nearly impossible for you, and only an original one feels done. Taking it apart first, you make your own version rather than follow the rule. Your work carries a mark nobody else could have left."

findings.quote: "Finish one job you have put off before Sunday."
findings.issue: "before Sunday" attaches to "put off".
findings.fix: "Seek Earth, the Order energy. Earth is the bank: it gives moving water a path and a shore. Let it shape what your Water pours. You hold more than you move, and what you do not move turns into weight. Before Sunday, finish one job you have put off. Keep the same day each week for one steady task."

findings.quote: "You spend the rest they had planned to take at the finish."
findings.issue: "the rest" reads first as "the remainder", and "finish" repeats the first sentence.
findings.fix: "Whenever enough is not enough, you keep your partners running past their finish. You push for the next round before asking, and they put in more than they meant. You use up the break they had planned to take at the end."

findings.quote: "whether you will pull your share"
findings.issue: It mixes two idioms ("pull your weight" and "do your share"). The "so" joint becomes "and".
findings.fix: "Carrying your own weight is the first thing you do. Being a load on nobody feels like safety, and you carry what is yours rather than hand a corner to a peer. Nobody ever has to wonder whether you will do your share."

findings.quote: "You put the shared stake before asking"
findings.issue: The particle is missing ("put up a stake").
findings.fix: "All in together means you take someone with you every time. You put up the shared stake before asking whose it was, and a partner carries losses they never signed for. Anyone in with you lives through each venture's lows as well as its highs."

findings.quote: "You go out after a chance and come home with something kept."
findings.issue: "chance" and "home" each appear 4 times on P173.
findings.fix: "Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Water gives it a current, and you gain most on the move. In balance, the current moves at your pace. You go out after an opening and come back with something kept."

findings.pages: P151, P152, P154, P155 (4 of the 5 Wood Balanced pages); across the corpus at least 15 of the 25 Balanced pages
findings.quote: P151: "In balance, what goes in keeps pace with the reach." then "Holding yourself up takes more than you are taking in." · P152: "In balance, you take in about as much as you give out." then "You run on your existing stores, and that feels like energy until it runs out." · P154: "Each venture gets finished and pays its way." then "You get hardest on yourself when your strength has nothing to build. Give it something." · P155: "In balance, the gate opens at your pace." then "Your output comes in bursts"
findings.issue: A Balanced page shows the catalyst advice, and that advice opens by naming a shortfall. The same page's definition says there is no shortfall, so the reader is told two opposite things a few lines apart. The S5 fix gave Balanced pages their own definition but not their own advice.
findings.fix: **Rule:** a Balanced page never shows a shortfall diagnosis. Option (a): one balanced advice per pair cell (25 texts). It opens with a diagnosis that names the balance and what keeps it, then gives two or three acts that keep the mix; the acts may be reused from the catalyst advice. Option (b): the Balanced page drops the advice's first sentence and shows only the acts under "Keep the mix." Option (a) reads better. **Evidence beyond Wood** (the Balanced advice as it renders on the other energies): Earth Action "The ground under your plans is thinner than they need"; Earth Order "few deadlines come to you from outside"; Fire Expression "Your light runs short"; Fire Body "putting back is the part you skip"; Metal Order "Little of the order in your life comes from outside you"; Metal Action "Your drive is short"; Metal Expression "little ever leaves your hands"; Metal Mind "You let in less than the world has to offer"; Water Mind "Your mind takes in less than it could use"; Water Expression "What you have to give runs short"; Water Body "a reserve that was small to begin with". **Sample Wood diagnoses for option (a):** 木_木 "Your strength holds because you feed it as fast as you spend it." · 火_木 "What you learn stays useful because you keep taking in while you give out." · 金_木 "Your ventures pay their way because you take on only what you can carry." · 水_木 "What you make keeps coming because you let out only what is ready."

findings.criterion: A1 (house rule: no chart arithmetic as a cause)
findings.quote: "Wood bears down past what your core holds, and the extra lands on you as blame."
findings.issue: The cause is chart quantity, not the reader's own need. On P015 the close's "Wanting only…" also repeats the "Wanting to be fair" opener two passages later.
findings.fix: "You are hard on yourself in ways you would spare a friend. Every slip feels like a test you failed, and the blame lands on you. All you want is to get it right, and you would rather pay for a mistake than fix it." (45 words)

findings.quote: "With more Wood than strength under it, you chase the fresh start over the finish."
findings.issue: The cause is chart arithmetic.
findings.fix: "Whatever is newest in front of you is what you chase hardest. Beginning is what wakes you up, and the fresh start wins over the finish. You leave a row of half-done things behind you, each one new when you started." (41 words)

findings.quote: "You have more Wood than strength for it, so you stay rather than face what leaving costs."
findings.issue: The cause is chart arithmetic, and staying in a place does not follow from having "more Wood than strength".
findings.fix: "Leaving comes hard to you, and you stay where the giving back stopped. Walking away writes off all you put in, and that scares you more than the drain. You keep paying in effort every month to a place that returns none of it." (45 words)

findings.quote: "You carry more Wood than stamina to match, so you trust proof over feeling."
findings.issue: Chart arithmetic is the cause, and "so you trust proof over feeling" does not follow from it. This sits under the page's best opener.
findings.fix: "Trusting takes you years, losing it an afternoon. Proof steadies you more than feeling does, and you wait for it before you let anyone close. You only want to be safe from hurt, and the long wait for proof hurts too." (41 words)

findings.quote: "Carrying less Wood than drive to spend, you notice the far chance more than the one in your hand. Half the good ideas in your circle started as something you pointed at."
findings.issue: The cause is chart arithmetic, and the close states a fact about the reader's circle that the reading cannot know.
findings.fix: "Spotting openings is what you do before anything is obvious. A far chance pulls at you more than the one in your hand, since the new one has more to give. You point at good ideas long before your circle sees them." (42 words)

findings.quote: "You have more push than Wood to put it into, so you build one thing for years rather than chase several."
findings.issue: The cause is chart arithmetic.
findings.fix: "Building slowly is where you feel most sure of yourself. What lasts matters more to you than what is new, and you build one thing for years rather than chase several. You still have that one thing standing when quicker efforts have fallen." (43 words)

findings.criterion: A4 (house rule: don't assume a partner)
findings.quote: "you give the person you are with your presence more than your feelings. Your partner gets all of your time and few of your words."
findings.issue: It assumes the reader has a partner.
findings.fix: "Loyalty is how you love, given rather than said. You rate being loyal above speaking up, and the people closest to you get your presence more than your feelings. You give them all of your time and few of your words." (41 words)

findings.quote: "The person beside you has never once doubted you."
findings.issue: It assumes a partner and states an absolute fact about the reader's past. "Being … Being" also opens two sentences in a row.
findings.fix: "Being loyal comes before being exciting for you. To be known feels safer than to be wanted, and you stay loyal on dull days as much as good ones. You give the people beside you nothing to doubt." (38 words)

findings.criterion: A4 (house rule: don't assume a child)
findings.quote: "you let a child or student set their own pace"
findings.issue: It assumes the reader has a child or a student in their care.
findings.fix: "With those in your care, you keep things relaxed. Since you would rather be enjoyed than obeyed, you let whoever is learning from you set their own pace. You teach without making anyone afraid of getting it wrong in front of you." (42 words)

findings.criterion: A4 (house rule: don't assume a boss)
findings.quote: "you give the person above you your best rather than the one beside you"
findings.issue: It assumes the reader has a boss.
findings.fix: "In how you treat people, rank comes first. Because a clear order feels safer than standing as equals, your best goes to whoever ranks highest. You send the credit for shared work upward, past your peers." (36 words)

findings.quote: "Promotions you deserved have gone to louder people."
findings.issue: It claims an event in the reader's past and assumes a job with promotions. The cost is right; the claim is not one the reading can make.
findings.fix: "Earning every step takes longer than asking for it. Since a rank you never requested sits easier on you, you wait for the title rather than claim it. You leave what you earned to louder people who asked." (38 words)

findings.criterion: D2, A1 (an error inside settled item 4; claimed past)
findings.quote: "you would rather shelter someone than be sheltered. Several friends got through their worst year under your roof."
findings.issue: The owner ruled that the Sage is drawn to shelter and that sheltering others grows from that want. This line denies the want outright, two lines under a definition that says you lack "a safe place to think it" (and against P011's "The safe place you look for…"). The close also claims a past.
findings.fix: "You take people in, spare bed and all. The shelter you want for yourself is the one you find easiest to give, and your door stays open. You make a friend's worst year a little softer under your roof." (39 words)

findings.quote: "You often run out before the thing is done."
findings.issue: It contradicts "Does it alone" on the same page ("you finish what others are still waiting on").
findings.fix: "Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Wood makes it growth, a reach fed by what goes in. Running thin, the reserve under your reach is small and every push draws on all of it. You save it for the few things that matter most." (49 words)

findings.quote: "Each venture gets finished and pays its way."
findings.issue: It contradicts the Horizon's "Quick to start" on the same page ("things you began and never saw through"). The Balanced definition should stay true under either persona's ledger.
findings.fix: "Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Wood makes it grow, so what you build adds up. In balance, what you take on matches the strength you have to carry it. You keep busy without wearing yourself down." (42 words; sentences 1 and 2 are the fixed head)

findings.quote: P006: "you keep your own pace instead … Some doors shut while you are still walking towards them" beside "Plan or no plan, you go first and let the rest catch up". P024: "you start before asking what it needs" beside "you are already saving". P027: "stop just short of the finish" beside "you go one step too far instead of stopping while it works"
findings.issue: Three pairs of near-opposites that the antonym list does not catch still meet on 2+2 pages. On P006 the filter also left a 3+1 page: three Twin keywords and one Rival, under a "2+2" blend.
findings.fix: Add three pairs to the picker's antonym list: Sets own pace × Goes first; Quick to start × Saves first; Coasts along × Goes too far. When a clash would leave 3+1, re-pick on the other persona so the page stays 2+2. Clean sets that exist: P006 Twin {Does it alone, Consistent} + Rival {Goes first, Loves a race}; P024 Horizon {Spots openings, Generous} + Steward {Patient builder, Loyal}; P027 Artisan {Coasts along, Comfort first} + Virtuoso {Talks back, Shows off}.

findings.criterion: A1 (M2: shared advice must be true of both personas)
findings.quote: "Your output comes in bursts, and the slow work in between stays hidden."
findings.issue: "Bursts" belongs to the Virtuoso ("the growth comes in bursts"). On the Artisan pages it sits under "the growth stays low to the ground" and beside the edge's "slow pulse a bad day cannot speed up".
findings.fix: "Much of what you make never leaves your hands, and the slow work behind it stays hidden. Take one idea you dropped last year one step further. Tell one person about a plan you have kept quiet. Add ten minutes to the same project every day for a month." (49 words)

findings.quote: "Metal is what stays when the wanting stops, the rest under the effort."
findings.issue: The cure is the Body (the reader's own strength), but the remedy names it "rest". That is not what the Body is, and it puts "rest" on each page three times, with the diagnosis and P019's "Spread thin".
findings.fix: "Seek Metal, your own Body energy. Metal is your own core under the effort, what stays when the wanting stops. Let it trim what Wood spreads. You treat rest as time stolen from building. Drop one project you no longer believe in. Choose three things for this month and turn down the others." (53 words)

findings.quote: "that puts the shared money at your size of risk. You set the size of a risk…"
findings.issue: "At your size of risk" is not idiomatic, and "size of risk" appears twice.
findings.fix: "Your biggest bets land on other people too. Going big matters more to you than going safe, and the shared money rides on your nerve. You choose a risk that the people who pooled with you have to carry." (39 words)

findings.quote: "Keeping things as they are feels safer than change, and you hold the family in place. You slow the move they wanted to the pace that feels safe to you."
findings.issue: "Safe" appears four times on the page, and "feels safer than" opens two passages in a row. "The family" assumes a household.
findings.fix: "When those close to you want to move, you stay put and stall. Any change reads to you as a risk, and you hold everyone where they are. You slow the move they wanted to the pace that suits you." (40 words)

findings.quote: "Because standing firm feels safer to you, you brace … You stay loyal to the old plan long after it has stopped working."
findings.issue: "Safer" has nothing to compare with. "Because" opens both Magistrate middles on the page, and "You stay … long after" repeats the definition's "You stay at attention long after".
findings.fix: "You never bend, whatever the day asks. Standing firm feels safer to you than giving way, and you brace against a change of plan instead of leaning into it. You keep faith with the old plan after it has stopped working." (41 words)

findings.quote: "Running thin, there is only enough of you for one."
findings.issue: "For one" what? The reader stops to fill the gap, and "Running thin" has no subject to attach to.
findings.fix: "Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Wood makes it growth, a reach fed by what goes in. Running thin, your reach covers one thing at a time. You put it on ground you know, and what grows there holds its shape." (46 words; tail only changed)

findings.quote: "Owing anyone feels like losing ground" (ledger[0]) then "Admitting a mistake feels like losing part of yourself" (ledger[1])
findings.issue: Two Twin passages in a row turn on "feels like losing". P003 then adds "Staying put feels like being passed".
findings.fix: "Being right is a comfort you never run out of. A mistake admitted costs you a piece of yourself, and you defend a wrong call as much as a right one. You come out of each argument right and without the lesson it held." (44 words)

findings.quote: "you take the quick start over the rest you are owed. Your life fills with things you began and never saw through."
findings.issue: The middle trades starting against rest, but the close's cost is unfinished work, so the two do not join up. "Whenever" also opens two passages on each of these pages.
findings.fix: "Something new opens, and you start before asking what it needs. Starting is where you feel free, and finishing feels like a door closing. You fill your life with things you began and never saw through." (36 words)

findings.quote: "your answer lands where the win was going. You take from them the try, and the pride of a win they reached alone."
findings.issue: Both images need a second read: the answer "landing where the win was going", and the inverted "take from them the try".
findings.fix: "Whenever someone you love struggles, you help before they ask. Fixing it yourself feels gentler than letting them try, and your answer arrives before theirs. You take away their try, and the pride of a win they would have reached alone." (41 words)

findings.quote: "and that gives your friends no way in"
findings.issue: "No way in" is used twice on the page (the definition: "Help finds no way in").
findings.fix: "You hold people at a distance that feels polite from your side. Being left alone matters more than being reached for, and your friends stay at the door. With that distance, you cost them a friend they could have reached."

findings.quote: "Holding yourself to one standard means holding friends to it."
findings.issue: It has the same opener as the advice on the page ("Holding yourself up takes…").
findings.fix: "One standard for yourself means one standard for your friends. Staying the same matters more than meeting anyone halfway, and an off day gets no slack. In a hard week, the people close to you get no softer version of you."

findings.quote: "Holding one standard for yourself keeps your footing"
findings.issue: It has the same opener as the advice on the page ("Holding yourself up…").
findings.fix: "You are the same person in any company. One standard for yourself keeps your footing, since a new shape for each group would cost you your measure. Friends never have to guess which you will turn up."

findings.quote: "means thinking it around, each side first"
findings.issue: "Thinking it around" is not English.
findings.fix: "Thinking a question through means walking all the way round it first. Being certain weighs more with you than being quick, so you take one more angle rather than decide. You circle a question for weeks that a single choice would have closed."

findings.quote: "You keep the idea safe"
findings.issue: This is the fourth "safe" on P007. "Whole" carries the same meaning and echoes "stays perfect".
findings.fix: "Keeping it in feels safer than being half understood. The private version stays perfect while the spoken one takes its chances, so you say the smaller idea. You keep the idea whole and lose the one thing you wanted from it, being known."

findings.quote: "so their nudge never comes"
findings.issue: "Their nudge" reads as a nudge from them. The meaning is the nudge they need.
findings.fix: "When someone close to you grows slowly, you give them time instead of a push. Holding back feels more like respect than a nudge, and the nudge they need never comes. Your patience leaves them to find the hard part on their own."

findings.quote: "feel like a debt you have not earned"
findings.issue: Two idioms are mixed: a debt is owed, not earned.
findings.fix: "Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Wood builds it upward, stage by stage. As a friction, the demands outgrow your strength and the pressure turns inward. Even an hour of ease begins to feel unearned."

findings.quote: "you reach for the book as you would for a form"
findings.issue: It does not parse on a first read. The meaning is that you treat the person like paperwork.
findings.fix: "Faced with a person, you reach for the book as if they were a form. Because an exception feels like playing favourites, you hand someone the rule rather than a hearing. Wanting to be fair, you give them a page in place of yourself."

findings.quote: "feels better than keeping … that would carry you all through"
findings.issue: "Keeping" has no object, and "carry you all through" reads as "all the way through".
findings.fix: "Spending on the people near you comes before your own next month. Because helping them feels better than holding on, you spend on their short weeks rather than a shared cushion. You spend the savings meant to carry all of you through a lean month."

findings.quote: "you count as closely as yourself"
findings.issue: The "for" is missing, so it reads as comparing you with yourself.
findings.fix: "You count as closely for those you love as for yourself. Since a cost stays with you longer than a pleasure, you count shared things aloud rather than let them pass. You take the small treats out of their days, one price at a time."

findings.quote: "so you pick pleasant hours over useful ones"
findings.issue: "Pleasant hours" is used twice on the page (the definition: "drains away into pleasant hours").
findings.fix: "You put comfort first for those in your care too. You would rather see them happy now than stretched, and you pick the easy choice over the useful one. You trade the effort they would grow on for an hour of ease."

findings.quote: "instead of standing by"
findings.issue: "Standing by" also means supporting someone or waiting on call. The meaning is being idle.
findings.fix: "Stopping feels like disappearing, and making keeps you here. The joy for you is in the making, and you make something new instead of staying idle. Fine work of yours sits in drawers, unseen and unthanked."

findings.quote: "switches your talent off, and you head off script"
findings.issue: "Off" appears three times in one passage, in two senses.
findings.fix: "Off script is how you stay interested. Sticking to a plan dulls your talent, and you head off script rather than see it through. Many of your best ideas end up half built and never shown whole."

findings.quote: "Speaking up for someone before being asked"
findings.issue: "Before being asked" also opens "Gives first" on the same page.
findings.fix: "Speaking up for someone who has not asked you to is a habit of yours. Because a wrong left standing bothers you more than overstepping, you say their piece ahead of them. Your voice fills the space their own words were meant for."
